evals.expected_output: An original hog (no band logo or existing mascot art) stomps a pedal and turns its big knob to max; the amp pumps and the hog headbangs on a held frame. White and dark GIFs at 200 x 200 that pass measure-gif.py, plus a published page.

evals.prompt: I want an owl that waves at visitors for my bookshop site, in that old Animation Factory style.
